title: Champion of Casterwill
summary: The first Champion of Casterwill was a master Seeker who fought on behalf of Lord Casterwill in battle and was the previous owner of Pendragon, the Legendary Titan of Champions. The title of champion was later supposedly taken on by Lok Lambert.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Champion of Casterwill fought alongside Lord Casterwill and his children in the war against the Nullifiers. [Sophie on Trial]

The Champion was present when Lord Casterwill used the Willblade to seal the Spiral Mark, and ensured that there was no one else about. [The Spiral Mark]

In the Fortress of Iron Will, Sophie Casterwill translated an ancient door to the vault of Mythras as only being accessible to the Champion of Casterwill. However, the door eventually opened to the power of Lok Lambert from the Willblade. [Sophie on Trial]

The Betrayer had Demigorgan, the Legendary Titan of Betrayal, use the Champion's image as a means of defeating Powerbonded Pendragon whilst fighting Lok Lambert. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
The first Champion of Casterwill was a master Seeker who fought on behalf of Lord Casterwill in battle and was the previous owner of Pendragon, the Legendary Titan of Champions. The title of champion was later supposedly taken on by Lok Lambert.

History

The Champion of Casterwill fought alongside Lord Casterwill and his children in the war against the Nullifiers. [Sophie on Trial]

The Champion was present when Lord Casterwill used the Willblade to seal the Spiral Mark, and ensured that there was no one else about. [The Spiral Mark]

In the Fortress of Iron Will, Sophie Casterwill translated an ancient door to the vault of Mythras as only being accessible to the Champion of Casterwill. However, the door eventually opened to the power of Lok Lambert from the Willblade. [Sophie on Trial]

The Betrayer had Demigorgan, the Legendary Titan of Betrayal, use the Champion's image as a means of defeating Powerbonded Pendragon whilst fighting Lok Lambert. [Dante's Return]

Abilities

As Lord Casterwill's number one warrior, the Champion of Casterwill was an extremely powerful Seeker.
